title: Pipeline merger validation, schema conformance and reasoning escalation

test_cases.name: Extraction and reasoning combination
test_cases.expected_result: Combined MergedResult contains all fields from both steps
test_cases.evidence: Merged result encapsulates extraction and diagnosis payloads

test_cases.name: Merged payload schema conformance
test_cases.input_setup: Validate serialization of MergedResult into structured log dictionary
test_cases.expected_result: Passes schema constraints with required types and keys
test_cases.evidence: Merged result serializes to valid schema log payload

test_cases.name: Validation failure escalation tracking
test_cases.input_setup: Configure MergedResult with validation failure state
test_cases.evidence: Escalation metadata correctly recorded on validation failure

test_cases.name: Merge execution determinism
test_cases.input_setup: Execute merge_step_results 10 consecutive times on identical input
test_cases.evidence: 10/10 consecutive merge executions produced bitwise identical outputs

test_cases.name: Partial merge on diagnosis failure
test_cases.expected_result: Extraction payload intact; diagnosis safely defaulted without crashing
test_cases.evidence: Partial merge cleanly handled: extraction preserved when diagnosis is None
